name: Better Search
description: A high-speed, zero-config drop-in replacement for the REDCap Add/Edit Records search page featuring smart query parsing (dates, phones, emails, multi-word tokens, choice labels) and a two-tier progressive search engine.

authors.name: Adam Nunez
authors.institution: UW Madison - Center for Tobacco Research and Intervention

project-settings.name: Better Search requires zero configuration: it automatically prioritizes your Record ID, Secondary Unique Field, Custom Record Label fields, Identifier (PHI) fields, and fields matching the detected input type (Date, Phone, Email).

Replace Native Add/Edit Records Page
Redirects the standard Add/Edit Records landing page to Better Search

Additional Fast Search Field
Optional fields to always include in the fast search query
